rulebook.title: 新津斗十四独立规则 v1

summary.deck: 52 ordinary cards plus configured 3/5/6/9 special cards; qiToWang changes only the four physical sevens.
summary.win: Four groups: sum-14 pairs, exposed same-rank triples, or quads; concealed four-pairs is independent.
summary.scoring: Package-backed fan table with qia20, longDui, xiaoHu, qia40/qia50 exclusivity and siGuiYi boundaries.
summary.declaration: Declaration locks the server-computed wait faces.
summary.payments: Exact per-payer 12-place rounding and no duplicate settlement.
summary.zeroFan: A legal structure meeting the red-point threshold wins at zero fan for one settlement unit.

rulebook.title: 安岳斗十四独立规则 v1

summary.deck: 52 ordinary cards plus one small king, one big king and one white face; qiToWang changes only the four sevens.
summary.win: Four groups: sum-14 pairs, exposed same-rank triples, or quads; concealed four-pairs is independent.
summary.piao: Piao is a payment-formula addend: none, mandatory one, or per-player 0/1 selection with timeout zero.
summary.scoring: Piao modifies the base factor before the capped fan formula; it is not a standalone fan item.
summary.payments: Self-draw charges every other player; discard charges the source; baopei makes the source pay all shares.

rulebook.title: 雅安红二十独立规则 v1

summary.deck: 52 ordinary cards; configured wang and enabled sevens are in-hand wildcards; qiWangNum=0 keeps ordinary sevens.
summary.win: Four groups of sum-14 pairs, same-rank peng/tou triples, or gang/ba quads; concealed four-pairs is an independent structure.
summary.scoring: The package-backed scorer uses explicit qia20, baoJiao, anDui/dragon, gang, color, and fifty switches.
summary.declaration: A declaration locks the server-computed wait faces; response melds are forbidden after declaration.
summary.goldHook: Three exposed peng/gang/ba groups plus two concealed cards that form a legal group after the winning card.

rulebook.title: 蒲江斗十四独立规则 v1

summary.win: Four groups: sum-14 pairs, exposed same-rank triples, or quads; concealed four-pairs is independent.
summary.scoring: Package-backed qia20, jinGouDiao, anDui/dragon, siGuiYi and optional keSuHu only on own flip/replacement.
summary.declaration: Declaration locks the server-computed wait faces.
summary.payments: Exact per-payer 12-place rounding and no duplicate settlement.

rulebook.title: 邛崃斗十四独立规则 v1

summary.deck: Approved QL-D03-1 pack: 52 ordinary cards plus equal 3/6/9/12/15/18 special reward cards.
summary.win: Four groups: sum-14 pairs, same-rank exposed triples, or quads; concealed four-pairs is independent.
summary.scoring: Independent fan table with explicit 4/5/6/99 caps and linear or exponential formulas.
summary.declaration: Declaration locks server-computed waits; response melds are not allowed after declaration.
summary.payments: Discard pays one share per winner; public flip charges every non-winner; exact 12-place payer rounding.

rulebook.title: 9:0 阿坝斗十四独立规则

summary.deck: 52 ordinary cards plus one small king, one big king and two white faces; no king-count selector.
summary.win: 必须形成合法四组结构，且结构分 >= huRedScore 才可胡牌。起胡线仅由 huRedScore 决定，playerNum 不缩放；同一手牌在 2、3、4 人配置下给出相同胡牌结果。
summary.threshold: 起胡线仅由 huRedScore 决定，playerNum 不缩放；playerNum 只影响入座、发牌和结算人数。
summary.scoring: Structure score/100 * 2^cappedFan * 0.8, with explicit 258, double-in/out, haidilao and baijiao facts.
summary.declaration: Declaration uses the configured threshold condition and locks the server-computed waits.
summary.payments: Exact per-payer 12-place rounding and no duplicate settlement.
